concept_sentence: A brave boxing rabbit must reclaim the stolen carrot harvest from sneaky snakes — punch them or jump on their heads, snack on carrots for health, and find easter eggs that power up its punch.
constraints: Enemies are snakes: can ONLY be defeated by jumping on their head (stomp) or punching them. Walking or running into a snake body is instant defeat (game over) — not gradual HP chips.
HUD must be compact and image-first: show health as a row of small carrot icons (not long HP text), small score number, keep punch power minimal; avoid a wall of HUD text
Player can wall-jump (Mario style): while airborn against the side of a solid platform/wall, jump again to leap off the wall and climb higher (double-jump via wall contact)
Punch attack pose must linger on screen long enough (~350–450ms) so the punch silhouette is clearly readable
Give a short story about what the rabbit wants (save the harvest / village feast)
Keep maps tiny and finishable (width about 36-45 tiles)
Cute readable art style, high contrast, DETAILED character sprites (face, gloves, limbs)
sprite_poses must include left/right idle, run, punch, hurt, and jump
Include at least a few carrots, easter eggs, and snakes in each level
